title: DoctorSid's Food Expansion
description: This mod transforms your kitchen into a culinary workshop, adding depth to the hunger system with new crops, complex recipes, and powerful buffs. This mod is perfect for players who want a more rewarding farming and cooking experience. On Curseforge Too.
body:
# DoctorSid’s Food Expansion

Tired of the same old bread and steak? DoctorSid’s Food Expansion breathes new life into your Minecraft kitchen by introducing a massive variety of snacks, meals, and treats to keep your hunger bar full and your taste buds happy. Whether you’re a casual explorer or a hardcore chef, this mod adds the culinary depth your world deserves.

## 🍎 Features

Diverse Snacks: Quick bites for when you're on the go—cookies, chips, and small treats. Hearty Meals: Full-course dishes.New Ingredients: Discover fresh crops and base items to expand your pantry. Farmer’s Delight Integration: Fully compatibility with Farmer's Delight.
![The Food](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7aaa9d579a9f4cb05a484aaeb432862a0b83063e.png) 

## 🛠 Installation

Download the version of DoctorSid’s Food Expansion that matches your Minecraft version. Locate your minecraft folder, Drop the downloaded .jar file into the mods folder then, Launch Minecraft using the appropriate profile.
